BiblicalUsage: Poratha is one of the ten sons of Haman, named in the list of the slain. Esther's story ends with Haman's house undone, and Poratha's name stands among the ten who fell with their father.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the fall of Haman's house shows that God answers the plotting of the proud, and no name on that list is there by accident.
